finalExitContract.changedPathRule: The final changedPaths set must enumerate every actual implementation-authority path and each must have a Pre/Post hook receipt; package creation paths alone cannot evidence implementation.
finalExitContract.businessAndCleanupRule: Each required focused or managed workload proof must retain run manifest, first failure, business result and cleanup result separately. No DEV/reset/seed/L2/UAT is in this package unless separately authorized.

FACT_BOUNDARIES: EnabledSelectedWorkspaceFact=15 fixed platform rows plus audit branch policy
BEHAVIOR_COUNTEREXAMPLES: all six audit enabled branches retain selected-workspace typed failure
CONTROL_AND_REVIEW: fresh IMPLEMENTATION independent review with at most two rounds
RUNTIME: NOT_APPLICABLE until a separate runtime authority is issued
future authorized managed workload must have business PASS and cleanup PASS

authorizationBoundary: Dexter explicitly authorized BP-U05 implementation and verification. BP-U06, SQL numeric optimization, DEV, reset/seed, L2/UAT, deployment and repository-control actions remain excluded.
